$comment: Token-program profiles: everything KOB needs per token program, in one place (docs/spec/token-programs.md). kob-protocol embeds this file (build.rs generates the TemplateId variants and the embedded sources from it); `kob registry add-program` derives a new entry; crates/kob-protocol/src/profile.rs validates every entry against the bytes on load.

programs.name: KCC20Ref
programs.summary: Reference KCC-20 (argent-lang/kcc20-reference c8a0871) at its default 3 / 3 token slots: KOB's standard program, the one `kob token issue` and the web app issue.

review.basis: internal review (maintainer decision 2026-10-12, canary launch); engine conformance suites, KAS-book order suites and their ablation run on it

programs.name: KCC20Ref_4x5
programs.summary: Reference KCC-20 prototype built with 4 token inputs / 5 outputs (tests and slot-limit coverage only).

review.basis: prototype build of the reference program; not on any registry

programs.name: KCC20Ref_8x8
programs.summary: Reference KCC-20 prototype built with 8 / 8 token slots (kept so that testnet tokens issued with it stay tradable).

review.basis: engine conformance suites; not issued by KOB

programs.name: KCC20Ref_16x16
programs.summary: Reference KCC-20 prototype built with 16 / 16 token slots (tests and slot-limit coverage only).

review.basis: prototype build of the reference program; not on any registry

programs.name: KCC20P2
programs.summary: KCC-20 variant P2 (3 / 3 slots; tests only).

review.basis: test variant; not on any registry

programs.name: KCC20KaspaCom_0_2_5
programs.summary: KaspaCom's KCC20 0.2.5 (contracts/third-party/kaspacom-kcc20, Apache-2.0): a third-party KCC-20-compatible program (112-byte state, draft tags, owner scheme 0x04, 8 / 8 slots, 25.5 KB).

review.basis: finding K-1 confirmed by an engine PoC (review_b2_kaspacom r_kc_05..07); minter lanes sit behind the extension commitment

programs.name: KCC20PublicMint
programs.summary: The KCC20 actor of upstream's published KCC20PublicMint app (argent-lang/kcc20-reference c8a0871), pinned as its KCC-1 actor-type handle: the context field moves into the 34-byte prefix, the open state is the 112-byte KCC-20 state. The program of third-party launchpads such as Kasseal.

companions.note: the app's PublicMint: its remaining allowance bounds the supply (supply + mint_allowance)
the app's TokenSeed: zero-amount holder factory

review.basis: internal review (maintainer decision 2026-10-13): order suites on its holders, the genesis suite (a Kasseal launch included), the executor flow test

programs.name: KronToken2433
programs.summary: The common KRON launchpad token program (2,433 B raw redeem script, 46-byte state at offset 0).

review.basis: internal review B2 (2026-09-30) with conditions: a per-token genesis check and no live minter before a token is listed or official

programs.name: KronToken2732
programs.summary: The newer KRON launchpad token program (2,732 B raw redeem script, 46-byte state at offset 0).

review.basis: internal review B2 (2026-09-30) with conditions: a per-token genesis check and no live minter before a token is listed or official

programs.name: KForgeToken1785
programs.summary: KForge launchpad token program (testnet-10, pre-standard): KRON 46-byte state behind a one-byte entry-selector prefix, 1,785-byte redeem script; holders are id_type 0 (token-level signature).

review.basis: derived by kob registry add-program; measured in the engine (crates/kob-tests/tests/program_kforgetoken1785.rs): the witness reproduced byte for byte, custody 2 and holder 0 (a token-level signature; address presence refused), slots 1 / 3, carrier floor 1 sompi, no minting, burning or minter on the transfer branch; served by the *KronD0 order builds; the other entries and the genesis not reviewed
